sources.name: Microsoft Policy CSP (Chrome and Edge ADMX)

applications.name: Google Chrome
applications.description: Managed preferences, ADMX policy and Managed Google Play configuration for Chrome.

settings.name: Set Chrome as the default browser
settings.description: Ask the user to make Chrome the default browser where macOS permits it, and stop other browsers taking the default silently.

settings.name: Send usage and crash reports
settings.description: Allow Chrome to send anonymous usage and crash data to Google. Disable for fleets that must not report telemetry.

settings.name: Allow the password manager
settings.description: Allow Chrome to save passwords. Disable when a corporate password manager is mandatory.

settings.name: Incognito mode
settings.description: Whether users may open Incognito windows.

settings.name: Show the bookmarks bar
settings.description: Show the bookmarks bar in Chrome windows.

settings.name: Set Chrome as the default browser
settings.description: Prevent the default-browser prompt from being suppressed and keep Chrome as the managed default.

settings.name: Send usage and crash reports
settings.description: Allow Chrome to send anonymous usage and crash data to Google.

settings.name: Allow the password manager
settings.description: Allow Chrome to save passwords for users.

settings.name: Send usage and crash reports
settings.description: Allow Chrome on Android to send anonymous usage and crash data.

settings.name: Allow the password manager
settings.description: Allow Chrome to save passwords on the device.

settings.name: Incognito mode
settings.description: Whether users may open Incognito tabs in Chrome on Android.

applications.name: Microsoft Edge
applications.description: Managed preferences, ADMX policy and Managed Google Play configuration for Edge.

settings.name: Set Edge as the default browser
settings.description: Ask the user to make Edge the default browser where macOS permits it.

settings.name: Send usage and crash reports
settings.description: Allow Edge to send anonymous usage and crash data to Microsoft.

settings.name: Microsoft Defender SmartScreen
settings.description: Enable SmartScreen URL and download reputation checks.

settings.name: Allow the password manager
settings.description: Allow Edge to save passwords.

settings.name: Set Edge as the default browser
settings.description: Prevent users changing the default browser away from the managed value.

settings.name: Send usage and crash reports
settings.description: Allow Edge to send anonymous usage and crash data to Microsoft.

settings.name: Microsoft Defender SmartScreen
settings.description: Enable SmartScreen URL and download reputation checks.

settings.name: Allow the password manager
settings.description: Allow Edge to save passwords for users.

settings.name: Send usage and crash reports
settings.description: Allow Edge on Android to send anonymous usage and crash data.

settings.name: Microsoft Defender SmartScreen
settings.description: Enable SmartScreen checks for Edge on Android.

applications.name: Mozilla Firefox
applications.description: Firefox enterprise policies delivered as managed preferences.

settings.name: Enable enterprise policies
settings.description: Required for the other Firefox preferences in this payload to take effect on macOS.

settings.name: Automatic updates
settings.description: Let Firefox install updates automatically.

settings.name: Background updates
settings.description: Keep updating Firefox while it is in the background.

settings.name: Disable telemetry
settings.description: Prevent Firefox from uploading telemetry.

settings.name: Automatic updates
settings.description: Allow the Slack desktop client to update itself.

settings.name: Disable automatic updates
settings.description: Disable Slack's built-in updater, for fleets that manage Slack versions themselves.

settings.name: Default workspace
settings.description: Workspace Slack signs in to by default (for example acme.slack.com).

settings.name: Release channel
settings.description: Update channel for the desktop client.

settings.name: Hardware acceleration
settings.description: Use the GPU to render Slack. Disable if it causes rendering problems on older Macs.

applications.name: Zoom
applications.description: Zoom desktop client single sign-on and login restrictions.

settings.name: Sign in with SSO automatically
settings.description: Open the SSO flow by default when Zoom starts.

settings.name: SSO sign-in URL
settings.description: Company Zoom sign-in URL, for example acme.zoom.us.

settings.name: Lock the SSO URL
settings.description: Stop users changing the SSO URL configured above.

settings.name: Disable Google sign-in
settings.description: Remove the Google login option from the Zoom client.

settings.name: Disable Facebook sign-in
settings.description: Remove the Facebook login option from the Zoom client.

settings.name: Open at login
settings.description: Start Teams when the user signs in.

settings.name: Disable GPU acceleration
settings.description: Render Teams without hardware acceleration. Useful on Macs with unstable GPU drivers.

applications.name: Visual Studio Code
applications.description: VS Code update, telemetry and extension policies.

settings.name: Update mode
settings.description: Controls whether VS Code checks for and installs updates.

settings.name: Telemetry level
settings.description: How much telemetry VS Code sends.

settings.name: Enable feedback mechanisms
settings.description: Allow the issue reporter and surveys.

settings.name: Default sign-in address
settings.description: Sign-in address users are prompted for, for example acme.1password.com.

settings.name: Enforce the sign-in address
settings.description: Stop users changing the sign-in address from the value above.

settings.name: Start at login
settings.description: Start 1Password when the user signs in.

settings.name: Allow 1Password to prevent sleep
settings.description: Allow 1Password to keep the device awake while it is active.
